scope: Operational definitions for the F09-frozen secondary pretreatment predictor names; these definitions do not alter H1-H3 or the material intervention.

predictors.connected_subtree_age_completed_updates: material-v4 selected.age: current parent completedUpdates minus the realised connected-subtree witness update
predictors.node_count: material-v4 selected.nodes for the selected inherited subtree
predictors.subtree_depth: material-v4 selected.depth, with a leaf depth of zero
predictors.recent_window_reach_rate: selected.reaching_rows divided by the 500-row revealed parent fitness window at the checkpoint
predictors.past_only_local_error: ordinary 0-1 error of the original selected subtree over the revealed recent-window rows that reach that site
predictors.past_only_balanced_error: mean of class-specific error rates over those same reaching rows when both classes occur; if a class is absent, use ordinary local error and set class_deficiency_indicator=1
predictors.class_deficiency_indicator: 1 exactly when one of the two binary classes is absent from the selected site's revealed reaching rows, otherwise 0
predictors.lineage_depth: longest parent-edge path of the deployed champion individual in an ancestry registry maintained from learner individual.parents: parentless depth=0, child depth=1+max(parent depths), retained individual depth unchanged
predictors.global_champion_literal_retention_fracti: fraction of unique node and internal-edge provenance tokens in the current deployed champion that are also present in the champion deployed immediately before the most recent completed parent update; the value computed at that update is carried unchanged until the next parent update
predictors.population_diversity: 1 - sum_h n_h(n_h-1)/(N(N-1)), where h is the semantic tree SHA-256 and n_h its multiplicity in the current N-member population; this is the probability that two distinct uniformly drawn population members have different semantic trees

timing: All predictor values are computed from the parent state and revealed history available at the checkpoint before the checkpoint treatment/update and before any post-checkpoint label is revealed.

missingness.no_eligible_material: material-site predictors are null and H3 primary eligibility is false; this is a boundary condition, not imputed missing data
missingness.zero_variance_later: F11 retains the predictor as a zero standardised column and reports the coefficient non-estimable, per F09
missingness.lineage_registry_failure: INFRASTRUCTURE_INVALID; do not replace with an approximate lineage metric

prohibitions: no future performance in predictor construction
no post-treatment quantity in predictor construction
no predictor deletion or redefinition after viewing H3 outcomes
no causal-mediation language for these secondary associations
